title: PortfolioDocument
description: The serialized form of an investment portfolio: candidate technologies, regional aggregations, policy requirements, their supplemental attributes and association tables, and sidecar files for the base power system and time series values. Every value is in natural units, except an embedded cost payload's own power_units. `base_system_file` and `time_series_storage_file` name the sidecars.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the portfolio.

data_source.description: Optional identifier of the source the portfolio data was drawn from.

aggregation.description: Qualified type name of the regional aggregation the portfolio groups its regions by. Resolved by the consumer; not a component in the document.

financial_data.description: Portfolio-wide financial parameters: the base economic year costs are discounted to, and the discount, inflation, and interest rates used. Absent if none.

components.description: Components grouped by type name, e.g. {"SupplyTechnology": [...]}. Spans aggregations, requirements, and technologies. Keys are sorted for deterministic output.

supplemental_attributes.description: Supplemental attributes as one flat array, not bucketed by type: RetirementPotential, RetrofitPotential, ExistingDevices, TopologyMapping.

supplemental_attribute_associations.description: Links each supplemental attribute (e.g. RetirementPotential, TopologyMapping) to the entity it describes. One row per (attribute, entity) pair.

investment_schedule.description: Optional investment decisions: the schedule of capacity installations produced by solving the portfolio. A model output, absent from an inputs-only portfolio.

time_series_associations.description: Time series metadata rows, one per (series, owner) association. Each names the store holding its values; `time_series_storage_file` is the sidecar name.

ext.description: Source data no schema field claims, keyed by component id. A consumer must consult a declared ignore list: a listed key is skipped, an unlisted key errors.

base_system_file.description: Basename of the sidecar holding the base power system this portfolio expands, or null if none. A name, not a path: resolved relative to this document.

time_series_storage_file.description: Basename of the sidecar holding time series values, or null if none. A name, not a path: resolved relative to the document.
